leads_no_state_excluded.note: Monthly 'New leads' = contacts created that month with a recognised AU/NZ state AND not an internal address. Excluded: (1) no recognised state (near-all spam/bot form-fills + legacy imports; country isn't collected on any form); (2) staff/self addresses (@wonderlandrv.com, anything with 'piyush'). None are real leads.

data_quality.deposits_handovers_method: From July 2026 these are counted from actual stage-change events (/dealActivities, dataType=d_stageid, cdate in month), deduped by chassis. The previous method (deals currently in the stage with mdate in the month) is unreliable: 47 Handover Complete deals were bulk-modified on 1-3 Aug 2026, which overwrote the July mdate signal and would have reported 0 deposits / 1 handover. Back-test on June: the event method returns 6 deposits (the 3 stored plus 3 VIC the mdate method missed) and 7 handovers vs 8 stored. Earlier months were left as recorded and are likely undercounted.
data_quality.configurator_submitters_correction: submitters_alltime recomputed as 66 (was 1826). The documented method GET /contactTags?filters[tag]=31 is silently ignored by the AC API and returns every contactTag row (24,584 across all tags). Verified correct filter: GET /contacts?tagid=31.
data_quality.deals_by_type_note: July uses the documented 5-bucket classifier (Ad enquiries / Configurator / Brochure downloads / Virtual consults / Other). Jan-Jun rows carry extra buckets (Campaign offers, Shows & events, Sales-entered / other) from an earlier undocumented classifier, so the type split is not directly comparable across the June/July boundary.
data_quality.automated_sends_note: August automated_sends is null, not zero. The documented method (bucket non-broadcast campaigns by ldate month and sum send_amt) is invalid: on an automation-linked campaign send_amt is the LIFETIME send count and ldate is the LAST fire date, so the whole lifetime total lands in whichever month the step last ran. Verified: 'Sales Email #5' was created Feb 2025 and carries send_amt 40 for 18 months of sends. Applying the method to August gave 9,372, of which 8,497 was just the four 'About Solara' nurture steps' lifetime totals. Re-running it on July now returns 80, not the 2,392 stored on 3 Aug, which shows the July and earlier figures are unreliable in the same way and are point-in-time artefacts. Broadcast metrics (count, sends, open %, click %) are unaffected and exact. A correct monthly figure needs a per-send source, not /campaigns.
data_quality.social_sync_lag_aug_2026: August social was pulled on 1 Sep 2026, before Vista had synced the final days: 30-31 Aug missing for YouTube, TikTok and Pinterest, and 31 Aug missing for both Instagram profiles and LinkedIn. Follower counts are complete for every channel and Facebook is complete. WL impressions are understated by roughly 27k of ~1.43M (about 2%) and OB by roughly 10k of ~430k. Re-pull August and replace the month entry to correct it.
data_quality.social_sync_lag_sep_2026: September 2026 pulled 1 Oct 2026 with the same 1-2 day Vista sync lag seen in August: YouTube and Pinterest missing 29-30 Sep, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn missing 30 Sep. Facebook complete. Follower snapshots complete. Social totals for September are a slight understatement until re-pulled.
data_quality.deposits_handovers_method_sep_2026: September counted from /dealActivities stage-change events (dataType d_stageid; the NEW stage id is in dataAction and the previous stage in dataOldval, dataId is always 0), event cdate converted to Australia/Melbourne and in the month, deduped by chassis. 409 stage-change events in September. Deposits 4 (VIC 2, SA 1, WA 1), handovers 13 (VIC 6, QLD 4, NSW 3). All monthly AC counts (contacts, deals, automation entries, broadcasts) use Melbourne-local month boundaries; the API returns US Central timestamps.
data_quality.configurator_sessions_note: configurator.sessions_alltime 5514 is carried forward (Gravity Forms form 26 entry count not reachable from the scheduled task); submitters_alltime 73 recomputed via GET /contacts?tagid=31 on 1 Oct 2026.
